Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.chart

Class ChartTicks

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.chart.ChartTicks
public final class ChartTicks extends Object
The ticks of the axes of a chart, and how their values are written. They depend only on the axes, not on the way the chart is drawn: the graphic renderers and the text one place their ticks at the same values, with the same labels.
